ModMetaData.name: EPrime's Quality Jobs
ModMetaData.author: Morten Mertner
ModMetaData.description:
Quality Jobs lets everyone work on unfinished items, but only qualified colonists are allowed to finish the job (quality outcome only depends on the finisher).
- Works for both crafting and construction. - Automatically hands the finishing touch to the best qualifying pawn, with support for inspirations and specialists. - Configurable defaults with override options per bill or buildable. - Unfinished work sharing also unblocks bills, so a colonist with an unfinished item doesn't block others from working at the bench.
Safe to add/remove mid-save (but when removing you must use the settings option to disable the mod, otherwise unfinished bill items will have to be cancelled). Designed for performance: cached rendering, no per-frame work, event- and interval-driven logic. Multiplayer compatible. Requires Harmony.
